title: Market Utils for Hypixel Skyblock
description: A Fabric client-side mod for Hypixel Skyblock that highlights profitable Auction House listings using colored slot borders and detailed profit-calculation tooltips.
body:
# MarketUtils                                                                              
                                                                                               
MarketUtils is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.10 that makes checking prices in
the Hypixel Skyblock Auction House (AH) fast, visual, and intuitive. It integrates with      
SkyHanni's market valuation data to highlight profitable listings directly on the item grid. 
                                                                                               
---                                                                                        
                                                                                               
### Features                                                                               
                                                                                               
* **Visual Profit Gradients**: Renders colored borders around auction slots so you can     
instantly evaluate price differences.                                                        
* **Deep Green**: Item is listed significantly below estimated value (50%+ margin).      
* **Yellow**: Fair price (listed within 3% of estimated value).                          
* **Deep Red**: Overpriced (listed significantly above estimated value).                 
* **Non-Overlapping Borders**: The colored indicators are thin 2px borders drawn at the    
slot edges. Rarity background colors from SkyHanni (pink for Mythic, yellow for Legendary,   
etc.) and item icons remain fully visible in the center.                                     
* **Calculated Profit Tooltips**: Hovering over an item adds a detailed profitability line 
to its tooltip, showing the exact percentage difference and estimated profit or loss in coins.
* **Optimized Performance**: Features background computation cache with frame throttling to
prevent FPS lag when opening a crowded Auction House menu.                                   
                                                                                               
---                                                                                        
                                                                                               
### Installation & Requirements                                                            
                                                                                               
* **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.10                                                           
* **Loader**: Fabric Loader >= 0.19.2                                                      
* **API**: Fabric API                                                                      
* **Dependency**: SkyHanni (required to provide the "Estimated Item Value" line that this  
 mod parses).                                                                                 
                                                                                               
---                                                                                        
                                                                                               
### Official Source & Security Warning                                                     
                                                                                               
Warning: To protect your Minecraft account and personal data, only download MarketUtils    from official sources:                                                                       
* **Modrinth**: https://modrinth.com/mod/marketutils                                       
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Fqrina/MarketUtils                                        
                                                                                               
Downloading this mod from unofficial sites or search portals risks downloading modified,   unsigned, or malicious JAR files. Always verify the integrity of the downloaded package.
